title: Holes drilled in wrong side of legs!
text: Holes drilled in wrong side of legs!. OF COURSE, you get to the END of Assembly and see the shelf support holes are showing - they were drilled in the front of legs  NOT BACK. Luckily, I had not used the locking washers YET - so I took it all back apart. :~(

product_metadata.title: Leick Wave Hall Console Table, Ivory Finish
features: Constructed of solid Ash wood and Oak wood veneers
Solid wood drawer construction with dovetail joinery for reliable use
Hand applied multi-step soft ivory finish
Lower display shelf for your favorite collectibles
Compact footprint for small spaces including condos, apartments, and dorm rooms
Simple, knock-down assembly ensures that setting up is a snap. Simply attach the legs, slide the drawer in, and you're done!
description: Create the perfect look in your home with the Leick Favorite Finds Ivory Wave Hall Console Table. At only 8" deep, this space saving design dares to boldly go where no furniture has gone before. Foyers, hallways, landings are all places ready for a finishing touch with this highly versatile design in a hand applied soft ivory, two-tone finish. Simple, knock-down assembly ensures that setting up is a snap. Simply attach the legs, slide the drawer in, and you're done! The table takes up a small space with a 10" W x 28" D x 28"H footprint.
